meta.title: Public comment tracker for munitions / OB/OD sites
meta.scope: Current or upcoming comment, petition, or hearing windows since January 1, 2026, plus recent closed items worth noting. Items are included only when a notice was retrieved. Blank date fields mean no date was stated in the source, not that a period is open.
gaps: This pass checked EPA public-notice pages and targeted state searches. It was not a complete scrape of every state hazardous-waste notice board.

A Kentucky legal advertisement appears to have described a June 2026 Blue Grass Army Depot emergency-permit comment window, but the official notice text was not retrieved (the advertisement URL returned 403, and Kentucky EEC's current waste public-notices page, checked November 23, 2026, did not list it). That item is omitted.

The St. Marks Powder item relies on a third-party reproduction of a Florida DEP Notice of Intent to Issue dated October 15, 2026 (legal number LSAR0614945). The original newspaper or DEP posting was not independently retrieved. The comment/petition close date of November 29, 2026, is 45 calendar days after that publication date, as the reproduced notice requires petitions or public-meeting requests to be filed within 45 days of publication.
EPA's two IAAAP emergency-permit notices are listed because they are recent official notices; EPA stated it was not requesting or accepting comments on either.
